title: A lantern goes home
context: An original fictional craft story in an imagined pre-industrial riverside town. Clothes and architecture are broad interpretations, not a documented event or exact historical reconstruction.
drawing: Flat color animation with soft closed silhouettes. People have oversized rounded heads, compact solid trunks, and broad rounded arm and leg shapes that carry visible mass. Small paddle-shaped hands and blunt feet finish the silhouette. Two upright dark pill marks are the only facial marks: no mouth, nose, brows, pupils or eye shine. Clothing covers the body normally, with no anatomy visible through fabric. Read emotion from posture, head angle and pauses. Use quiet edges and limited shading; avoid glossy toy surfaces and mechanical additions.

cast.jun: Jun is an adult lantern maker with a warm brown rounded face, two dark upright pill eyes and black hair in a low knot secured by a plain wooden pin. She has a compact, fully filled figure, a dark jade cross-collar robe, a rust-colored apron, cream lower-leg wraps and rounded brown shoes. Her visible forearms and paddle-shaped hands are warm brown filled forms with clear width. No nose, mouth or eyebrows are drawn. Preserve the low knot, robe, apron and warm brown face.
cast.bo: Bo is an older adult carrier with a light tan round face and two dark upright pill eyes. A short silver braid emerges below a soft slate cap. An ochre long tunic, black fabric belt and dark brown rounded boots cover a broad compact filled body. The visible tan forearms and hands have soft solid silhouettes. There is no drawn mouth, nose or eyebrow. Keep the braid, cap, tunic and body proportions consistent.

props.lantern: One unlit pale-yellow paper lantern with a bamboo hoop, curved bamboo handle and one visible reinforcing rib; no writing or emblem.

voices.reader: An off-screen adult woman speaking standard Mandarin in a gentle middle register. The sound is clear and lightly resonant, with smooth phrase endings, natural pauses and an unhurried conversational pace. Use a close recording without room echo. Preserve this speaker throughout; characters do not speak or move a mouth.

audio.music: A sparse recurring pattern of soft wooden plucks with long quiet gaps, mixed below the narrator; an editorial score, not a claim of authentic period music

exclude: Hairline arms or legs, empty ring heads, extra facial marks, cloned people or objects, anatomy showing through clothing, unrequested lettering, watermarks and brand marks.

shots.setting: A fictional riverside lantern workshop: timber posts, a low workbench, a lattice window and an open doorway toward the river path. Muted jade, rust and honey colors surround flat cartoon people.

lantern.place: upright at the center of the low workbench

beats.action: Vertical medium view at bench height. Jun reaches with the left hand and closes it around the bamboo handle.
The lantern lifts slightly clear of the bench. Jun steadies its loose bamboo rib with the right hand while the left hand supports the handle.
Jun withdraws the right hand, leaving the straightened lantern hanging from the left hand beside the apron.

lantern.place: left hand around the bamboo handle, lantern beside the apron

lines.speaker: reader
lines.text: 竹骨扶正，纸罩就重新站稳了。

beats.action: Cut to the jade sleeve, rust apron and lantern. Jun lowers the lantern with the left hand while the right hand guides the base.
The base makes full contact with the center of the bench and bears the weight. Both hands then release and withdraw.
Hold on the upright unlit lantern with empty space around it. The cropped hands remain outside the frame rather than being redrawn beside the object.

lines.speaker: reader
lines.text: 她把灯放下，等来取灯的人。

beats.action: Return to a vertical two-person composition, Jun farther back left and Bo nearer right. Bo approaches the workbench while Jun keeps her hands clear.

lines.speaker: reader
lines.text: 他先托住灯底，再慢慢提起。
